rationale: Base station storage was at 99% with loop recording disabled, producing error E-402 and stopping new event recording (timeline stopped at end of last month). The purple LED and firmware-update suspicion were red herrings; live view/notifications still worked because those don't require storage. Enabling loop recording resolved the issue, confirming STORAGE_FULL as an L1-closeable cause.

repair_steps: Confirm loop recording is enabled in Base Station Settings > Storage.
Verify new events are recording and timeline is updating.
If customer wants to keep existing clips, guide them to export clips then format storage.
Confirm error E-402 is cleared and no other issues remain.
output.customer_reply: We've resolved the issue by enabling loop recording on your base station. New events should now be saved normally. If you'd like to keep existing clips, please export them before formatting storage. Let us know if you need further assistance.
